Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - S.C.C. No. 310/2023

Dear Mr. Kamath,

Thank you for meeting us on 31/01/2024 about your dispute with M/s Pioneer Textiles Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
